android.desc:
Take control of your digital life with Focus Detox: Screen Time Control – your all-in-one solution to reduce screen time, block distractions, and build better focus habits.
In today’s world of constant notifications and endless scrolling, staying focused is harder than ever. Focus Detox helps you break phone addiction, improve productivity, and create a healthier relationship with your device.
🌿 Why Choose Focus Detox?
Designed with a clean, minimal interface and calming green-blue tones, Focus Detox creates a peaceful experience while helping you stay in control of your digital habits.
🚀 Key Features:
📵 App Blocker (Focus Mode)
Block distracting apps like social media or games and stay focused on what matters.
⏱ Screen Time Tracker
Track your daily usage and understand where your time goes.
🎯 Focus Sessions
Start deep work sessions and avoid interruptions.
🔔 Smart Reminders
Get gentle nudges to take breaks and reduce overuse.
📊 Daily Goals & Insights
Set limits, track progress, and build mindful habits.
🌙 Minimal & Calm UI
A distraction-free design that promotes focus and mental clarity.
💡 Who is this for?
Students who want better concentration
Professionals aiming for higher productivity
Anyone struggling with screen addiction
Users looking for a digital detox and mindful lifestyle
🌱 Benefits:
✔ Improve focus and productivity
✔ Reduce screen time and phone addiction
✔ Build healthier digital habits
✔ Feel more calm and in control
Focus Detox is more than just an app blocker — it’s your personal companion for a balanced digital lifestyle.
Take the first step towards a calmer, more focused life.
Start your digital detox today.
